company.shortDescription: Trubuild is an AI-powered platform for construction procurement, tender evaluation, vendor analysis, and decision tracking.
company.description: TruBuild is a procurement intelligence platform for construction enterprises managing complex tender evaluations. The platform centralizes technical reviews, commercial assessments, contract management, cost analysis, vendor intelligence, and tender communications into a single governed workflow. It provides traceable recommendations, audit-ready records, and clear accountability, helping teams make faster, more informed, and defensible procurement decisions.
